title: Tomato restrictions eased in Italy after Salmonella concerns
content:
An Italian region has lifted restrictions on the use of most fresh tomatoes in food service.

Officials in Foggia said raw tomatoes can now be served unless they come from Caltanissetta or Ragusa. The change was made based on the updated epidemiological situation and guidance from the regional health authority.

title: Aldi recalls pasta because of botulism risk
content:
